name: Path To Dominion
source:
This is a story that mostly unfolds in August City; A land of magic, opportunity, and never-ending crime.


In the Prologue, you enter our young protagonist; An impish young recruit who has been reduced to a shadow of himself.  After being humiliated by your own actions in the Academy, a series of events force you to rediscover who you are.

In Chapter 1, we go lucid as we take a wild turn to bring New Truths to light and shift the story into a whole new reality.

And in Chapter 2, our young antihero turns his back on justice. And embarks on a journey to steal freedom and destroy all that is sacred. (There are no heroes... only buried evil or worse.)

Step into his shoes as he chooses abyss over utopia.
Between foul enemies, lust-driven allies, and the heavy fate which trails your unknown past...
How stormy will the road to your ultimate goal be?
Will you ever reach this said destination?

Join this journey. And together we shall find our Path To Dominion.

[From [url=https://darksummerleaf.itch.io/path-to-dominion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个主要在八月城展开的故事；这是一片充满魔法、机遇和永无休止的犯罪的土地。


在序言中，你进入了我们年轻的主角；一个顽皮的年轻新兵，已经沦落为自己的影子。在因自己在学院的行为而受到羞辱后，一系列事件迫使你重新发现自己是谁。

在第一章中，我们通过疯狂的转变来揭示新真理并将故事转变为全新的现实，从而变得清醒。

在第二章中，我们年轻的反英雄背弃了正义。并踏上了窃取自由、摧毁一切神圣的旅程。（没有英雄……只有埋葬邪恶或更糟。）站在他的立场上，他选择了深渊而不是乌托邦。
在邪恶的敌人、欲望驱使的盟友以及追随你不为人知的过去的沉重命运之间……
通往最终目标的道路会有多艰难？
你会到达这个目的地吗？

加入这个旅程。我们将共同找到统治之路。

[来自[url=https://darksummerleaf.itch.io/path-to-dominion]itch.io[/url]]
